cases.name: registration_order
cases.reason: Synchronous receivers run in registration order.

cases.name: fail_fast
cases.reason: First receiver failure stops delivery; Go also returns the attempted receiver inventory.

cases.name: robust
cases.reason: Later receivers run after an ordinary failure; Go uses typed errors and an explicit logger.

cases.name: disconnect_before_send
cases.reason: Removed receivers do not participate in later sends; repeated removal has no effect.

cases.name: connect_during_send
cases.reason: Registration during a send first participates in the next snapshot.

cases.name: disconnect_during_send
cases.reason: Django retains a selected receiver in the current snapshot; Go stops any not-yet-admitted call so resource owners can unsubscribe and drain.

cases.name: nested_send
cases.reason: A receiver can synchronously send the same event again.

cases.name: duplicate_dispatch_uid
cases.reason: Django silently deduplicates dispatch_uid; Go rejects duplicate receiver names explicitly.

cases.name: sender_filter
cases.reason: Django filters by sender identity; Go owners choose separate typed Event instances and do not mirror Python object identity.
